items.source: requiredType - the type that each result object is expected to match
items.translation: requiredType - 每个结果对象预期匹配的类型

items.source: The default implementation calls JdbcUtils.getResultSetValue(java.sql.ResultSet, int, Class). If no required type has been specified, this method delegates to getColumnValue(rs, index), which basically calls ResultSet.getObject(index) but applies some additional default conversion to appropriate value types.
items.translation: 默认实现调用JdbcUtils.getResultSetValue(java.sql.ResultSet, int, Class)。如果未指定所需类型，此方法会委托给getColumnValue(rs, index)，该方法基本上调用ResultSet.getObject(index)，但会对适当的值类型应用一些额外的默认转换。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to JdbcUtils.getResultSetValue(), which uses the ResultSet.getObject(index) method. Additionally, it includes a "hack" to get around Oracle returning a non-standard object for their TIMESTAMP datatype. See the JdbcUtils#getResultSetValue() javadoc for details.
items.translation: 默认实现委托给 `JdbcUtils.getResultSetValue()`，该方法使用 `ResultSet.getObject(index)`。此外，它包含一个“变通方法”，以解决 Oracle 为其 TIMESTAMP 数据类型返回非标准对象的问题。有关详细信息，请参阅 `JdbcUtils#getResultSetValue()` 的 javadoc。

items.source: If the required type is String, the value will simply get stringified via toString(). In case of a Number, the value will be converted into a Number, either through number conversion or through String parsing (depending on the value type). Otherwise, the value will be converted to a required type using the ConversionService.
items.translation: 如果所需类型为 String，该值将通过toString()直接转换为字符串。如果是 Number 类型，该值将通过数值转换或字符串解析（取决于值的类型）转换为 Number。否则，将使用ConversionService将该值转换为所需类型。

items.source: Default is the DefaultConversionService.
items.translation: 默认值为DefaultConversionService。

items.source: Validates that there is only one column selected, then delegates to getColumnValue() and also convertValueToRequiredType, if necessary.
items.translation: 验证仅有一列被选中，然后委托给 `getColumnValue()` 以及必要时调用 `convertValueToRequiredType`。

items.source: The type of the result value for each row can be specified. The value for the single column will be extracted from the ResultSet and converted into the specified target type.
items.translation: 每行结果值的类型可以指定。单列的值将从 `ResultSet` 中提取并转换为指定的目标类型。

items.source:
If not specified, the column value will be exposed as
returned by the JDBC driver.
items.translation: 如果未指定，列值将按 JDBC 驱动程序返回的方式暴露。
